title: Coming attractions, and the closing sale
lede: Two commercials from the years of fastest growth, local news and an investment manager’s commentary from the 2010 bankruptcy, and a staff training tape. Where the year comes only from the uploader, the caption says so.

videos.title: Hollywood Video commercial with a movie-trailer voiceover
videos.caption: A 30-second spot in the style of a film trailer. The uploader dates it to 1998 and credits the voice to Don LaFontaine; we could not confirm either. The upload is a 2021 remaster. The chain had 1,260 stores at the end of 1998.[^2]

videos.title: Hollywood Video commercial: five-day rentals
videos.caption: A spot promoting a new release for five days. The 2000 date is the uploader’s. That was the year the company closed Reel.com’s store and reported its largest loss.[^3]

videos.title: KRQE: “Hollywood Video shuts most ABQ stores”
videos.caption: A short report from KRQE, the Albuquerque station, published on its own channel on February 5, 2010, days after Movie Gallery’s second Chapter 11 filing.[^15]

videos.title: An investment manager on the Hollywood Video bankruptcy
videos.caption: Shawn Narancich of the investment firm Ferguson Wellman discusses the bankruptcy. Published on the firm’s channel on March 8, 2010. It is commentary, not a source for any figure on this page.

videos.title: Hollywood Video staff training video
videos.caption: A 22-minute training tape on greeting and selling to customers. The 2009 date is the uploader’s; the upload is from 2016.

note: Upload dates were read from the YouTube pages in October 2026. We could not reach the Internet Archive from our research environment, so no archived footage is included.
